title: EXP-021 — Static Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: Create one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab01`, add exactly one Static component using the replay-verified component procedure, give that component a unique FX_-prefixed name and set only its Caption to exactly `Static Caption Close Only`, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to a demonstrably clean state, close the target through its ordinary Form-tab close control without explicit form/global-object unload, reopen the same User-scoped Form through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path, and verify that the same Static component is present with the exact Caption recovered unchanged. acceptance_checks.description: Before mutation, visibly establish a usable Mongoose context, User editing scope, and target absence: a case-insensitive visible Select Form Name filter for `FX_StaticCaptionLab01` returns no matching row, and a positive-control filter demonstrates the same Select Form surface is live. If session recovery is required before mutation, complete it before proceeding and record it; once mutation begins, later recovery is prohibited.

The target Form is closed through its ordinary Designer Form-tab close control with no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt, and no explicit unload, Regenerate, reload, preference change, reauthentication, or Designer replacement occurs.

The target is reopened through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path in the same Designer client/browser context. The reopened Form is visibly identified as `FX_StaticCaptionLab01` and its scoped identity matches the recorded User-scope baseline.

After reopen, `FX_StaticCaptionStatic` is present and its Caption is exactly `Static Caption Close Only`; the Designer is clean and all recorded non-Caption comparison properties remain equal to baseline. Evidence must visibly identify the target component/result, with any exact value obtained only from accessibility/property state explicitly labeled as such.

Final record audit establishes exactly one ordinary Save, one ordinary target close, one recent-forms reopen, no prohibited action after mutation began, and repository changes confined to the EXP-021 record plus `evidence/EXP-021/`. Do not require a post-creation Web Client exactly-one inventory query for acceptance.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261005-235851-rw3E. Rationale: Form-level Description recovery across ordinary close/reopen is replay-verified and Form-level Caption recovery is observed, while component-level Caption recovery remains unestablished. EXP-020 is blocked/unknown around Button Caption handling, so this proposal deliberately chooses a different component type whose placement/configuration procedure is already replay-verified: Static. This isolates one new capability—whether one saved Static component Caption is recovered after an ordinary Designer Form-tab close and supported recent-forms reopen—without retrying the blocked Button path or the blocked EXP-010 replay. The decisive postcondition is Designer-level scoped Form identity plus the exact Static component identity/property after reopen; final Web Client inventory cardinality is not required.
